query: What explicit endogeneity estimation hierarchy and decision rules (when to accept control-function vs IV results) will we pre-specify to handle contradictory findings?

response.query: What explicit endogeneity estimation hierarchy and decision rules (when to accept control-function vs IV results) will we pre-specify to handle contradictory findings?
response.answer: We will pre-specify to use control functions if endogeneity is suspected but IV results are weak or inconsistent; otherwise, IV will be preferred for stronger causal inference.
